question: Nadir Shah was the ruler of ________ who conquered and plundered the city of Delhi in 1739.
solution:
The correct answer is__ I**ran**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nadir Shah,** the ruler of Iran, invaded India in **1739 **and plundered the **city of Delhi.**
 
• This was a significant event in Indian history as it marked the** decline of the Mughal Empire **and the rise of **regional powers**.
 
• Nadir Shah
